cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: I want {faction} on friendly terms with us, and I want it in two weeks. We trade on the same ground as them, so they're either a customer or a problem. Favours, gifts, a fair deal, and they stay a customer.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Let's get {faction} to like us. Not love. Like. They've got the same buyers we have, and a firm that's liked gets its calls returned and its prices left alone. Disliked, it gets leaned on.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Our next job is {faction}. I want them well disposed to us by the end of the fortnight. Cheaper to buy a friend now than to pay a rival's legal bills later.
